definitions.explanation: A particular manner or way something is designed or done, especially in art or architecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧{様式|ようしき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This building is in Western style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{様式|ようしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The way of living has changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{様式|ようしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the documents in the specified format.

notes:
{様式|ようしき} refers to an established style, form, or mode, especially in architecture, art, and culture. It implies a recognized pattern or convention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{様式|ようしき}: lifestyle, way of living
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{様式|ようしき}: architectural style
- ⟦{和|わ}→和〜：00418_wa⟧{様式|ようしき}: Japanese style
- ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：noentry⟧{様式|ようしき}: Western style
- {様式|ようしき}⟦{美|び}→美：noentry⟧: beauty of form/style

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方式|ほうしき}→方式：05454_houshiki⟧: system, method — more technical and procedural
- ⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧: format, formality — focuses on outward form or structure
- ⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧: style (loanword) — more casual, broader usage
- {様式|ようしき} implies a traditional or established convention, while ⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧ is more personal

Also used for document templates or prescribed formats: ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{様式|ようしき} (specified format).
